newsitem.title: UK: BoE says strong demand, stg sharpens dilemma.
newsitem.headline: BoE says strong demand, stg sharpens dilemma.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Thursday that rapid expansion of domestic demand, led by consumption, and the further appreciation of sterling has sharpened the dilemma for monetary policy.
But its monetary policy committee still decided to raise base rates by a quarter-point to 6.75 percent.

"It (the committee) that the latest month's evidence, notably the upward revision of estimated output growth and retail sales, indicated that a further tightening of monetary policy was necessary, nothwithstanding the further appreciation of the exchange rate and the contractionary effects of the recent Budget," a Bank statement said.
